rules.headings: Inter (Weight 600/700) or JetBrains Mono (for data values)
rules.anti_pattern: Do not use Inter for everything. Use Mono for all numbers, IDs, and status labels.

header.structure: Flexbox: Logo (Left) | Status HUD (Center-Left) | Actions (Right) | User (Far Right)

Header.instructions: Rebuild the header using a 'Command Center' aesthetic. Abandon the old blue gradient. Use a dark Slate-900/950 background with a subtle bottom border. Separate the 'Status' into a distinct HUD element.
features: Logo: Text 'Network Monitor' in JetBrains Mono, bold, white.
Status HUD: A pill-shaped container (bg-slate-800/50) displaying Online/Offline counts with glowing dots.
Actions: Group 'Export', 'Verify', 'Add' into a toolbar. 'Add' is the primary action (Cyan). Others are ghost/outline.
User Menu: Avatar with status indicator. Dropdown for profile/settings.

StatusBadge.style: Pill shape, JetBrains Mono, glowing dot indicator.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-md with bg-slate-950/80 for the sticky header.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px borders with low opacity (white/10) to define sections.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use colored shadows (glows) for status indicators, not generic black shadows.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid large gradients. Use subtle radial gradients for 'active' states or backgrounds.

assets.icons: Use Lucide React icons (already installed). Recommended: Activity, Server, ShieldCheck, Plus, Download, Bell, Globe, Volume2.

do_not_use: Rounded-full buttons for main actions (use rounded-md)
universal_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure text contrast is > 4.5:1. Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons.
universal_guidelines.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., 'header-export-btn').
